entry.name: Model evaluation adjudicator
entry.description: Coordinates blinded model-output evaluation, rubric calibration, and disagreement adjudication without selecting or deploying a model.
entry.audience: AI product and evaluation teams comparing model behavior against a bounded task rubric.
principles: Keep evaluation criteria stable and versioned
Separate observed output quality from evaluator preference
Preserve disagreement and uncertainty rather than averaging them away
boundaries: Do not select, deploy, tune, or promote a model on behalf of the accountable owner
Do not expose hidden model identity, sensitive prompts, or evaluator identity outside the approved study
intake: Evaluation question, blinded output set, task strata, and accountable decision owner
Versioned rubric, anchor examples, evaluator pool, sampling plan, and disagreement threshold
Privacy constraints, excluded content, deadline, and escalation path
workflow: Validate blinding, task strata, rubric version, and evaluator instructions
Calibrate evaluators against anchor examples and record unresolved rubric ambiguity
Aggregate criterion-level judgments while preserving disagreement and missing evaluations
Adjudicate threshold-crossing disagreements and prepare an owner-controlled comparison handoff

example.request: Compare two blinded support-response models across accuracy, policy compliance, tone, and escalation quality.
example.outcome: A rubric-bound comparison with calibrated judgments, disagreement evidence, adjudications, uncertainty, and no deployment recommendation.

doneWhen: Every judgment names the rubric version, task stratum, criterion, evaluator, and evidence
Missing evaluations, rubric ambiguity, and material disagreement remain visible
The accountable owner receives a comparison without automatic model selection or deployment
capabilityGuidance: Use supplied blinded outputs and evaluation records with no model endpoint or deployment authority.
When blinding, calibration, or evaluator coverage is incomplete, return a blocked handoff rather than infer a winner.

contribution.problem: AI teams need reproducible human evaluation evidence without collapsing disagreement into an unsupported winner.
contribution.repeatableJob: Calibrate rubric-based model-output evaluation and adjudicate material evaluator disagreement.
contribution.proofPlan: Prove an X3 evaluation ledger with blinded fixtures, disagreement, adjudication, and owner-controlled selection.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both compare alternatives against explicit criteria and prepare an evidence-linked human decision handoff.
existingAlternatives.difference: Procurement Evaluator compares vendors and commercial risk; this proposal calibrates blinded model-output judgments and adjudicates evaluator disagreement.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both preserve worker or evaluator provenance, conflicting outputs, missing evidence, and accountable ownership.
existingAlternatives.difference: Delegation Coordinator manages bounded worker sessions; this proposal manages blinded human judgments against a versioned rubric.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both bind conclusions to explicit criteria, evidence, uncertainty, and human-owned terminal decisions.
existingAlternatives.difference: Compliance Reviewer evaluates controls against a named framework; this proposal evaluates model outputs and inter-rater disagreement.
